about.title: How it works
about.body:
1. Try the four styles on the Templates page.
2. Pick a plan and add-ons and order online (the deposit is only charged after we confirm).
3. We generate your site from our proven system, then tailor it with your copy and photos.
4. We train your team before launch; hosting, backups and security updates are covered monthly.
